UduthiPaar™

AI virtual trial room for garment showrooms.

Customers see how a fabric or garment looks on them before it is stitched or bought. UduthiPaar brings AI try-on into the showroom and onto the store's website.

Who it's forTextile and apparel showrooms, boutiques, tailoring studios and online fashion sellers.

Visit UduthiPaar™ ↗Book a demo →

What it does

  • Assisted selling sessions: staff guide the customer while results appear on a customer-facing display.
  • AI virtual try-on using several leading image models, so results stay fast and realistic.
  • Fabric and stock management: admins upload fabrics, record stock intake and manage store users.
  • Partner API and e-commerce widget for adding try-on to an existing online store.
  • Privacy built in: try-on photos are cleaned up automatically on a schedule.
Live

KanakkuPaar™ கணக்குப்பார்

Billing and stock for small shops, in Tamil and English.

A phone-friendly billing app that a shop owner can learn in minutes. Tap products to bill, take Cash or UPI, share the receipt, and know exactly what is in stock.

Who it's forVery small shops, home-based sellers and cloud kitchens with a focused catalogue of around 30–50 products.

Visit KanakkuPaar™ ↗Get your shop onboarded →

What it does

  • Fast billing: search products by Tamil or English name, tap to add, pieces or kg/g/litre/ml quantities, fixed discounts.
  • Cash and UPI payments, optional customer details, review before completing.
  • Receipts to print, save as PDF or share on WhatsApp; cancellations need a reason and are kept on record.
  • Stock tracking: opening stock, add stock, counted adjustments with reasons and full movement history.
  • Reports for today, this week, this month or any date range.
  • Android app that shops can install from a shared link, plus a prepaid wallet with simple recharges.

SevaiPaar™ சேவைப்பார்

Service-request management, from first call to closed job.

The office logs a job in three steps, assigns a technician, and follows it to completion. Technicians get a simple phone app that keeps working even with a weak signal.

Who it's forUPS/inverter, AC, fridge, RO, copier, computer and CCTV service shops and agencies.

Visit SevaiPaar™ ↗Join the beta →

What it does

  • Today board: new, overdue and on-hold jobs, AMC visits due, contracts ending and payments due.
  • Customers and machines: multiple service addresses, serial numbers, warranty, service history and a printable QR sticker per machine.
  • Full job lifecycle with a timeline and a status link the customer can open from WhatsApp.
  • Technician app: call, WhatsApp, directions, photos, spare parts used and the customer's signature, with an offline queue.
  • Spare parts and AMC contracts with stock history and scheduled visits.
  • Automatic WhatsApp/SMS updates to customers as the job moves forward.
Launching in Salem

Muttram முற்றம்

The family courtyard, on every phone.

Named after the open courtyard of a Tamil home where the family gathers, Muttram is a private space for one family to talk, share, plan and look out for each other. Tamil first, also in English, Telugu and Hindi.

Who it's forFamilies who want a calmer, private alternative to the busy family WhatsApp group, especially those caring for children and elders.

Visit Muttram ↗

What it does

  • Daily family question with a family streak; answers stay hidden until you share yours.
  • Private chat and shared photo album with "On this day" memories.
  • Household needs: a shared grocery list plus recurring needs like milk, rent, gas and EMIs, with monthly spend.
  • Birthdays, anniversaries and Tamil festivals with reminders and one-tap greeting cards to share.
  • Safety: hold-to-send SOS with location to the whole family, a family map and live location for an hour.
  • Easy invites with a 6-letter family code shared over WhatsApp.
₹Coming soon

PayFees

Tuition fee collection without the chasing.

One platform for many institutes. Parents pay by UPI QR or in cash, with no payment-gateway fees, and owners always know who has paid and who is overdue.

Who it's forTuition centres, coaching institutes, music and dance classes, and independent teachers.

Register interest →

What it does

  • Students and batches with fee plans and due dates.
  • UPI QR or cash payments recorded against each student.
  • Automatic fee reminders to parents, plus a one-tap "Send reminder".
  • Reports on collections, unpaid fees by batch and overdue students, with CSV export.
  • Simple sign-in with an emailed code or Google; only people the institute adds can get in.
  • Flexible plans: a monthly subscription or a small commission on collections.

Take One

A casting desk for production units.

Production units manage every project's casting call in one workspace: applications come in from connected accounts, the team reviews candidates, schedules auditions and drafts replies.

Who it's forFilm, web-series and advertising production units and casting teams.

Talk to us →

What it does

  • Production units and projects with Active, Paused and Wrapped status.
  • Connection-based intake: applicants arrive from linked accounts such as WhatsApp, with no file uploads or chat exports.
  • Candidate review and shortlisting per project.
  • Audition scheduling and correspondence drafts.
  • Portfolio view of projects and applicant totals across production units.

SwiftRide

A complete ride-hailing platform for local fleets.

Everything a city taxi or call-taxi business needs to go digital: apps for riders and drivers, a console for fleet owners and a console for the platform operator, connected by live dispatch.

Who it's forCall-taxi operators, fleet owners and regional mobility start-ups.

Request a demo →

What it does

  • Rider app: upfront fares for multiple ride types, live ETAs, scheduled rides, promo codes, cash, card or wallet.
  • Trip safety: PIN-verified pickup, shareable live trip link and SOS alerts.
  • Driver app: go online, accept offers, start trips with the rider's PIN and track earnings.
  • Fleet-owner console: live fleet, drivers, vehicles, analytics and payouts.
  • Platform admin: marketplace analytics, live operations, approvals, pricing, promotions and support.
